title: Boolean monomial
statement: For a finite set $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and a Boolean vector $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, define its monomial to be the product over $i\in S$ of the indicator that $x_i=1$. Thus the value is $1$ exactly when every coordinate indexed by $S$ is $1$, and is $0$ otherwise.
